hazards.location_in_image: Curbside adjacent to the sidewalk

hazards.name: Lack of marked crossings
hazards.description: There are no designated or marked crossing points for pedestrians between the residential buildings and the recreational area.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the center of the roadway

hazards.name: Visual obstructions from parked cars
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the left curb block sightlines between drivers and pedestrians who might attempt to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the roadway

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: Parked cars along the curb block the view of the street for pedestrians, particularly children, and hide pedestrians from oncoming drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curb line

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Buffer
hazards.description: There is no physical separation (such as trees, bollards, or parked cars) between the sidewalk and the active travel lane.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curb line in the foreground

hazards.name: Litter and debris
hazards.description: Scattered litter on the sidewalk can create minor tripping hazards or indicate neglect.
hazards.location_in_image: On the sidewalk in the foreground and midground on the left.

hazards.name: Degraded Gutter Pavement
hazards.description: The pavement in the gutter area shows signs of cracking and debris, which could be a trip hazard for those stepping off the curb.
hazards.location_in_image: Bottom center of the image at the curb edge.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstruction
hazards.description: A portable toilet is placed directly on the narrow sidewalk on the left, forcing pedestrians to step into the roadway to pass.
hazards.location_in_image: Left foreground sidewalk

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: Continuous parallel parking on both sides of the street limits sightlines between drivers and pedestrians, particularly children who may be near the playground.
hazards.location_in_image: Both sides of the roadway

hazards.name: Visual obstruction from parked vehicle
hazards.description: A large white van with a ladder rack significantly blocks the view of the sidewalk from the roadway, creating a hazard for pedestrians who might step into the street.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground, parked at curb

hazards.name: Lack of sidewalk buffer
hazards.description: The sidewalk is directly adjacent to the curb with no physical separation or green strip, placing pedestrians close to moving traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of image

hazards.name: Lack of street lighting
hazards.description: No street light poles are visible in the immediate frame, which may create safety and security concerns for pedestrians at night.
hazards.location_in_image: Entire streetscape

hazards.name: Lack of shade and buffer
hazards.description: The total absence of street trees or a furniture zone leaves pedestrians exposed to the elements and provides no physical or psychological buffer from the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curb line

hazards.name: Uneven sidewalk surface
hazards.description: Visible patches and cracks in the concrete walkway create potential trip hazards for pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and mid-ground sidewalk area

hazards.name: Lack of pedestrian-vehicle separation
hazards.description: The sidewalk is directly adjacent to the travel lane with no physical or psychological buffer.
hazards.location_in_image: Edge of the sidewalk along the curb line

hazards.name: Absence of Street Lighting
hazards.description: No street lighting fixtures are visible in the immediate vicinity, which may reduce safety and security for pedestrians at night.
hazards.location_in_image: Entire streetscape

hazards.name: Sidewalk Encroachment
hazards.description: Building steps and personal items like chairs and trash cans narrow the effective walking width of the sidewalk.
hazards.location_in_image: Left and right sidewalks adjacent to row houses

hazards.name: Driveway Conflict Point
hazards.description: A wide driveway between the two buildings allows vehicles to cross the pedestrian walkway, creating potential for collisions.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the image, between the grey and brick buildings.

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions
hazards.description: Continuous parallel parking on both sides of the narrow street obscures sightlines between drivers and pedestrians, particularly children.
hazards.location_in_image: Along both curbs throughout the block

hazards.name: Uncontrolled Intersection
hazards.description: The intersection ahead has a marked crosswalk but no visible stop signs or traffic signals to regulate vehicle movement.
hazards.location_in_image: Center background at the intersection.

hazards.name: Utility poles on sidewalk
hazards.description: Utility poles are located within the sidewalk area, which may narrow the effective walking width for pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Left and right foreground on the sidewalks.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming (Speed Humps)
interventions.description: Install speed humps to reduce vehicle speeds on this narrow residential and recreational street.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Implement curb extensions at the nearest intersection to improve visibility and reduce crossing distance.

interventions.title: Install Detectable Warnings
interventions.description: Add truncated dome pads to the curb ramps to comply with accessibility standards and improve safety for visually impaired pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Add a median refuge to allow pedestrians to cross the wide street in two stages.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane at corners to shorten crossing distances and improve pedestrian visibility.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signals to give pedestrians a head start before vehicles get a green light.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Enhancements
interventions.description: While zebra markings are present, adding additional signage or lighting can further alert drivers.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer Zone
interventions.description: Implement a dedicated furniture or planting zone to relocate utility poles and trees, providing a physical buffer between pedestrians and moving traffic.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Add marked, high-visibility crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way across the wide roadway.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening and Obstruction Removal
interventions.description: Widen the sidewalk or relocate utility poles to ensure a clear, accessible path of travel for all users, including those with mobility aids.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces closest to intersections or mid-block crossing points to improve sight lines.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install a marked mid-block crosswalk with high-visibility paint to formalize pedestrian crossing points.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planters
interventions.description: Add a furniture zone with trees or planters to provide a physical and psychological buffer between pedestrians and traffic.

interventions.title: Regular Maintenance
interventions.description: Implement regular street and sidewalk cleaning to remove debris.

interventions.title: Midblock Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility marked crosswalk with appropriate signage to provide a safe crossing point to the playground.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Clearance
interventions.description: Relocate the portable toilet and any other temporary structures off the pedestrian walkway to maintain a clear path of travel.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer
interventions.description: Install a planting strip or furniture zone between the sidewalk and the curb to provide physical and psychological separation from traffic.

interventions.title: Street Trees
interventions.description: Planting trees along the sidewalk would provide a better buffer between pedestrians and moving traffic.

interventions.title: Street Tree Planting
interventions.description: Install street trees along the curb to provide shade, improve the aesthetic environment, and act as a natural traffic calming measure.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Install street lighting to ensure the wide sidewalk is well-lit for safety and security during nighttime hours.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Rehabilitation
interventions.description: Repair and level the sidewalk surface to eliminate trip hazards and ensure ADA compliance.

interventions.title: Street Trees or Planters
interventions.description: Install street trees or large planters to provide a physical buffer between pedestrians and vehicles.

interventions.title: Speed Humps
interventions.description: Implement speed humps to physically enforce low vehicle speeds in this residential setting.

interventions.title: Daylighting at Intersections
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces near the ends of the block to improve sight lines between pedestrians and approaching vehicles.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planting Strips
interventions.description: Install a furniture or planting zone between the sidewalk and the curb to provide a physical and psychological buffer from moving vehicles.

interventions.title: Driveway Narrowing
interventions.description: Reduce the width of the driveway opening to slow entering and exiting vehicles and minimize the conflict area for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks
interventions.description: Add high-visibility crosswalk markings to designate safe crossing points.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming
interventions.description: Implement speed humps or cushions to ensure vehicle speeds remain low in this residential context.

interventions.title: Intersection Control
interventions.description: Install stop signs or traffic signals to clearly define right-of-way and improve safety for pedestrians crossing.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming Measures
interventions.description: Implementing speed humps or cushions to ensure low vehicle speeds on this narrow residential street.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer/Furniture Zone
interventions.description: Install a planting strip or furniture zone to separate pedestrians from moving traffic.

interventions.title: Utility Undergrounding
interventions.description: Relocate overhead utilities underground to remove poles from the sidewalk and improve accessibility.
